# porkbun_glue_records (Data Source)

Retrieve all glue records (host objects) registered under the domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porkbun_glue_records" "test" {
  domain = "jiancodes.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain for which to retrieve glue records.

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (Attributes Map) Map of hostnames to their IP addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Read-Only:

- `ips` (Set of String) The IP addresses (IPv4 and/or IPv6) associated with the host record.
